name: desearch-mcp-server

tools.name: ai-search
tools.description: AI search and analysis on web using Desearch AI

prompt.description: Question, example: 'What is the latest news on AI?'

tools.description: Source ids sent to POST /desearch/ai/search. Short ids: 'web', 'twitter', 'arxiv', 'wikipedia', 'hackernews', 'reddit'. Legacy labels such as 'Web Search', 'ArXiv Search', 'Wikipedia Search', 'Hacker News Search', and 'Reddit Search' are rewritten to those ids. Example: ['web', 'twitter'].

date_filter.description: Deprecated relative window; prefer start_date/end_date. Example: 'PAST_WEEK'

start_date.description: Start of the date range in UTC (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ). Use with end_date.

end_date.description: End of the date range in UTC (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ). Use with start_date.

result_type.description: ONLY_LINKS returns links only; LINKS_WITH_FINAL_SUMMARY adds an AI summary. Link arrays are kept under whichever key the API uses, along with billing fields. ONLY_LINKS still depends on the API to include those links.

include_domains.description: Restrict Web Search results to these domains, example: ['bbc.com', 'reuters.com']

exclude_domains.description: Drop Web Search results from these domains, example: ['pinterest.com']

model.description: Model to use for the search: NOVA (default) or ORBIT.

tools.name: x-search
tools.description: Search X (Twitter) using Desearch AI. Optional filters narrow by user, date, language, verification, media, and engagement. Sort stays Top.

query.description: Twitter advanced search query, example: 'from:elonmusk since:2023-01-01 min_replies:10'

count.description: Number of search results to return (default: 20), max is 100

start_date.description: Start date in UTC (YYYY-MM-DD). Use with end_date.

end_date.description: End date in UTC (YYYY-MM-DD). Use with start_date.

is_quote.description: Include only posts that are quotes.

tools.name: web-search
tools.description: SERP-style web search using Desearch. Returns ranked titles, links, and snippets.

query.description: Search query, example: 'latest news on AI'

start.description: How many results to skip for pagination (0, 10, 20, ...). Omit for the first page.

tools.name: web-links-search
tools.description: Search the web for links using Desearch. Only the web source is accepted.

prompt.description: Search query prompt, example: 'open source browser automation tools'

tools.description: Sources to search. Only 'web' is accepted; other ids are rejected before the API call. 'Web Search' is accepted and rewritten to 'web'. Defaults to ['web'].

count.description: Results to return per source. Min 10. Max 200.

tools.name: x-links-search
tools.description: AI search for X (Twitter) post links using Desearch. Returns links from posts that match the prompt.

prompt.description: Search query prompt, example: 'Bittensor subnet updates'

tools.name: x-posts-by-urls
tools.description: Fetch full X (Twitter) posts for a list of post URLs.

tools.name: x-post-by-id
tools.description: Fetch a single X (Twitter) post by its ID.

id.description: The unique ID of the post, example: '1234567890'

tools.name: x-posts-by-user
tools.description: Search X (Twitter) posts by a specific user, with an optional keyword query.

query.description: Advanced search query to filter this user's posts.

tools.name: x-post-retweeters
tools.description: List users who retweeted an X (Twitter) post. Pass cursor to page through more users.

id.description: The ID of the post to get retweeters for.

cursor.description: Cursor for pagination from a previous response.

tools.name: x-user-posts
tools.description: Retrieve a user's X (Twitter) timeline posts by username. Pass cursor to page through more posts.

username.description: Username to fetch posts for, example: 'elonmusk'

cursor.description: Cursor for pagination from a previous response.

tools.name: x-user-replies
tools.description: Fetch posts and replies by an X (Twitter) user, with an optional keyword query.

user.description: Username of the user to search for, example: 'elonmusk'

query.description: Advanced search query to filter this user's posts and replies.

tools.name: x-post-replies
tools.description: Fetch replies to an X (Twitter) post, with an optional keyword query.

post_id.description: The ID of the post to fetch replies for.

query.description: Advanced search query to filter replies.

tools.name: extract
tools.description: Extract a public URL and return its content as plain text or HTML using Desearch. Preferred over web-crawl for new integrations. API docs: https://www.desearch.ai/docs/api-reference/get-web-extract

js.description: Render JavaScript before reading the page.

wait.description: Post-load wait in milliseconds when JavaScript rendering is enabled.

tools.name: web-crawl
tools.description: Crawl a public URL and return its content as plain text or HTML on the legacy Desearch /web/crawl route. The SDK marks webCrawl deprecated in favor of extract; this tool stays for parity with that route. Prefer extract for new integrations. API docs: https://www.desearch.ai/docs/guide/apis/extract-api

js.description: Render JavaScript before reading the page.

wait.description: Post-load wait in milliseconds when JavaScript rendering is enabled.

tools.name: x-trends
tools.description: Retrieve trending topics on X (Twitter) for a location by its WOEID using Desearch.

woeid.description: WOEID of the location, example: 23424977 for the United States.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the public web and return titles and links. Use fetch with a result URL to read the page.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Read a public page as text. Pass a URL returned by search.

id.description: URL of the page to read.

tools.name: people-search
tools.description: Start a paid job billed to the user's Desearch balance: find people on X, YouTube, LinkedIn, or TikTok who match a plain-language description. Each person comes back with a fit score, why they matched, their audience, and public contacts and links. This call reserves count times the platform's per-person price (reserved_cost_usd) and returns a task_id at once. When the search ends you pay only for the people it delivered (a per-search minimum applies when it finds anyone; a search that finds no one is free) and the rest of the reservation is returned. The search runs in the background, usually for 1 to 5 minutes: poll people-search-status with the task_id to read progress and the people found so far, and use people-search-control to pause, resume, or cancel it. Do not start the same search twice; send idempotency_key so a retry returns the first task instead of charging again. Filters depend on the platform. x: min_followers, max_followers, verified_only, countries, keywords, exclude_keywords. youtube: min_subscribers, max_subscribers, countries, require_contact, keywords, exclude_keywords. linkedin: min_followers, max_followers, countries, keywords, exclude_keywords. tiktok: min_followers, max_followers, require_contact, keywords, exclude_keywords.

platform.description: Where to look: 'x' (X profiles), 'youtube' (YouTube creators), 'linkedin' (LinkedIn members), or 'tiktok' (TikTok creators).

query.description: Who you are looking for, in plain language, example: 'Skincare creators who review sunscreen'.

count.description: How many qualified people to find (5-200, API default 25). The search reserves this many and bills only the people it delivers.

min_score.description: Only return people with at least this fit score (0-100).

exclude.description: Handles to leave out, for example people you already contacted.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string for this search, for example a UUID. Sending the same key again returns the first task and is not charged again.

metadata.description: Your own labels for this search, example: {"campaign": "q4-outbound"}. Up to 10 keys; keys are 1-40 characters of a-z, 0-9, '_', '.', '-'; values are strings of up to 200 characters. Returned on the task; filter people-search-tasks by it. The search does not use it.

min_followers.description: Minimum follower count. x, linkedin, tiktok.

max_followers.description: Maximum follower count. x, linkedin, tiktok.

verified_only.description: Only verified or X Premium accounts. x only.

require_contact.description: Only creators with a public email (tiktok: in the bio; youtube: an email or contact link). youtube, tiktok.

countries.description: Countries to prefer, example: ['US', 'GB']. x, youtube, linkedin.

keywords.description: Words that should appear in their posts, videos, or bio. All platforms.

exclude_keywords.description: Leave out people who mention these words. All platforms.

tools.name: people-search-status
tools.description: Status, progress, and cost of one People Search task, plus a page of the people found so far: name, handle, url, platform, audience, location, fit score, why they matched, contacts, and links. Free. People arrive while the search runs: pass the returned next_cursor as cursor on the next call to get only the people found since then. When done is true and has_more is false you have everyone the search found. An ended task has completion_reason (why it stopped), coverage_limited: true when a budget stopped it before count (more people may match), and warnings such as partial_enrichment (some profiles could not be read, so those people were scored on the search hit; they show enrichment: failed). Each person has fully_verified (every criterion confirmed by their own profile or posts) and unverified_criteria (criteria that are unknown or not met, or a disqualifier that applies). These are information only: the person still qualified.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous people-search-status call. Omit to start from the first person.

include_people.description: Set false to read only the status, progress, and cost.

tools.name: people-search-control
tools.description: Pause, resume, or cancel a People Search task. Free. pause: a queued search pauses at once; a running one finishes its current batch first (status pausing, then paused). A search paused for more than 7 days is cancelled. resume: continues a paused search where it stopped, with no new charge. cancel: stops the search for good; you pay only for the people it already delivered and the rest of the reservation is returned. People found so far stay readable for 30 days.

tools.name: people-search-tasks
tools.description: Your People Search tasks, newest first, with status, counts, cost, why each ended search stopped (completion_reason, coverage_limited), and the metadata labels set on people-search. Free. Use it to find a task_id (filter by metadata to find the searches of one campaign), or to see which searches are still queued, running, or paused: a new search is refused while too many are active.

platform.description: Only tasks on this platform: 'x', 'youtube', 'linkedin', or 'tiktok'.

status.description: Only tasks in these statuses, example: ['running', 'paused'].

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page. Keep the same metadata filter when you page.

metadata.description: Only tasks whose metadata has all of these key/value pairs (exact match, up to 3), example: {"campaign": "q4-outbound"}.

tools.name: people-profiles
tools.description: Everyone your People Searches found on one platform, one entry per person: their best-scoring result and the search that found them (found_by). Free; it does not run a new search. Search by name, handle, bio, or location with q, filter by contact channels (has), audience, fit score, location, or verification, and sort by score, recent, or audience. People from searches that ended more than 30 days ago are left out.

q.description: Text in the name, handle, bio, or location, example: 'skincare'.

has.description: Channels every person must have, example: ['email', 'instagram']. 'email' is a public email; the others are a link of that type.

location.description: Text in the location, example: 'united states'.

verified.description: Only verified accounts. Only X and TikTok people carry a verified flag.

instructions: Search the public web and X with Desearch. Use search for titles and links, then fetch with a result URL to read the page. Other tools cover AI search, X posts, and page extraction. People Search finds people and creators on X, YouTube, LinkedIn, and TikTok: people-search starts a paid job billed to the user's Desearch balance, people-search-status reads progress, and people-search-control can pause, resume, or cancel it. Calls need a Desearch API key.
